messages:
jess: quick question — for the /v1/generate endpoint, when the client sends a payload that parses fine but fails our domain validation (eg prompt length, invalid model param), should we be returning 400 or 422? want to be explicit in the contract so SDKs can decide retry behavior. cc @ryan
ryan: my take: 400 = syntactic / schema-level (bad JSON, wrong types), 422 = semantic validation (business rules like prompt too long or unsupported combina- tions). both are client errors and not retryable by default. :thumbsup:
miguel: +1 to separating them. to avoid guesswork i propose we include a stable machine code: `error.code` and an explicit `error.retriable` boolean in the body so callers don't need to infer from status alone.
jess: example shape? also should we standardize headers (Retry-After) in any of these?
miguel: example response i was thinking:```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "prompt_too_long",
    "message": "Prompt exceeds 65536 characters",
    "retriable": false
  }
}
```
This makes SDKs simple: check `retriable` first.
katherine: small nuance: 429 stays for rate limiting (client exceeded quota) and should include `Retry-After`. 409 should be reserved for conflicting state (eg model locked for upgrade, or an idempotency conflict). For capacity/overload we still use 503 and set `retriable: true` in body.
ryan: agreed. also we should document which codes are considered "client-fixable" vs "transient" in the API guide so ops/SDKs can map to backoff strategies. i can add a table to the contract doc.
jess: sounds good. i'll update the API spec draft: add `error.code` enum, recommended `retriable` semantics, and examples for 400/422/409/429/503. can someone add a quick unit test for the generator that asserts `retriable` false on validation failures?
miguel: i'll add tests + a small paragraph in errors.md. will open PR and ping reviewers. ETA EOD.
ci-bot: circleci/status — all checks passed for branch `feat/error-guidance` :white_check_mark:
jess: thanks everyone — i'll link the PR in the spec doc when it's up. if anyone has objections to the `retriable` field naming now's the time. otherwise i'll proceed.
